scientific_integrity: All-parameter proof plus bounded exhaustive subspace checks; finite checks not used as infinite proof. The prior ambient homotopy theorem and representation paper are expressly not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: For n>=3 and pure binary translation subgroups at inclusive scale two only. The recent group-action paper was accessible by abstract but not in full; equivalence risk remains.
title: Geometric fixed loci of all binary translation subgroups at Hamming scale two
